29#[derive(Debug)]
30pub(crate) struct Type3<'a> {
31    widths: Vec<Width>,
32    missing_width: f32,
33    /// PdfCraft patch (90): the width each code's glyph procedure gives with `d0`/`d1`, read
34    /// the first time the code is shown in a font without `/Widths`. One cell per code.
35    proc_widths: Vec<OnceCell<Option<f32>>>,
36    encoding: Encoding,
37    encodings: HashMap<u8, String>,
38    dict: Dict<'a>,
39    char_procs: HashMap<String, Stream<'a>>,
40    glyph_simulator: GlyphSimulator,
41    font_bbox: Rect,
42    matrix: Affine,
43    to_unicode: Option<CMap>,
44    /// PdfCraft patch (87): glyph procedures already decoded, by glyph name, so a glyph shown
45    /// again and again (a Type 3 font used as a fill pattern draws one glyph hundreds of
46    /// thousands of times) isn't inflated again for every copy. Only procedures of at most
47    /// [`MAX_CACHED_PROC`] bytes are kept, and the fonts of one interpreter cache keep at most
48    /// `context::MAX_CACHED_TYPE3_PROCS` bytes together.
49    decoded_procs: RefCell<HashMap<String, Rc<[u8]>>>,
50    /// PdfCraft patch: whether the font's numbered glyph names all name their own codes
51    /// (`numbered_names_name_their_codes`), worked out on first use.
52    own_code_names: OnceLock<bool>,
53}
54
55/// PdfCraft patch (87): the largest decoded glyph procedure [`Type3`] keeps.
56const MAX_CACHED_PROC: usize = 64 << 10;
57/// PdfCraft patch (87): what a kept procedure costs the cache besides its bytes and its glyph
58/// name (the map entry and the shared allocation's counts), so many empty procedures count too.
59const CACHED_PROC_OVERHEAD: usize = 64;
60
61impl<'a> Type3<'a> {
62    pub(crate) fn new(dict: &Dict<'a>, cmap_resolver: &CMapResolverFn) -> Option<Self> {
63        let (encoding, encodings) = read_encoding(dict);
64        let (widths, missing_width) = read_widths(dict, dict)?;
65        let font_bbox = dict
66            .get::<crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Rect>(FONT_BBOX)
67            .unwrap_or(crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Rect::ZERO)
68            .to_kurbo();
69
70        let matrix = Affine::new(dict.get::<[f64; 6]>(FONT_MATRIX).unwrap_or([0.001, 0.0, 0.0, 0.001, 0.0, 0.0]));
71
72        let char_procs = {
73            let mut procs = HashMap::new();
74            let dict = dict.get::<Dict<'_>>(CHAR_PROCS).unwrap_or_default();
75
76            for name in dict.keys() {
77                if let Some(prog) = dict.get::<Stream<'_>>(name.as_ref()) {
78                    procs.insert(name.as_str().to_string(), prog);
79                }
80            }
81
82            procs
83        };
84
85        let to_unicode = read_to_unicode(dict, cmap_resolver);
86
87        Some(Self {
88            glyph_simulator: GlyphSimulator::new(),
89            encoding,
90            font_bbox,
91            char_procs,
92            widths,
93            missing_width,
94            proc_widths: vec![OnceCell::new(); usize::from(u8::MAX) + 1],
95            encodings,
96            matrix,
97            dict: dict.clone(),
98            to_unicode,
99            decoded_procs: RefCell::new(HashMap::new()),
100            own_code_names: OnceLock::new(),
101        })
102    }
103
104    /// PdfCraft patch (87): the decoded procedure of glyph `name`, held within the page's
105    /// content budget while the glyph is painted, whether it was decoded now or kept from an
106    /// earlier copy, so a page skips the same glyphs either way once the budget is spent. It is
107    /// decoded the first time and kept, when small enough and while `procs` has room, for the
108    /// next copies. Only a procedure decoded with more budget left than [`MAX_CACHED_PROC`] is
109    /// kept, so one the budget may have cut short isn't.
110    fn decoded_proc(&self, name: &str, program: &Stream<'a>, procs: &Type3Procs) -> Option<(Rc<[u8]>, HeldContent)> {
111        let kept = self.decoded_procs.borrow().get(name).cloned();
112        if let Some(bytes) = kept {
113            let held = hold_content(bytes.len())?;
114            return Some((bytes, held));
115        }
116        let left = content_left();
117        // PdfCraft patch: see `context::MAX_PAGE_CONTENT`.
118        let decoded = crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::context::decode_content(program)?;
119        procs.decodes.set(procs.decodes.get().saturating_add(1));
120        let bytes: Rc<[u8]> = Rc::from(decoded.as_ref());
121        drop(decoded);
122        let held = hold_content(bytes.len())?;
123        let cost = bytes.len().saturating_add(name.len()).saturating_add(CACHED_PROC_OVERHEAD);
124        let total = procs.held.get().saturating_add(cost);
125        if left > MAX_CACHED_PROC && bytes.len() <= MAX_CACHED_PROC && total <= MAX_CACHED_TYPE3_PROCS {
126            procs.held.set(total);
127            self.decoded_procs.borrow_mut().insert(name.to_string(), bytes.clone());
128        }
129        Some((bytes, held))
130    }
131
132    pub(crate) fn map_code(&self, code: u8) -> GlyphId {
133        self.encodings
134            .get(&code)
135            .map(|s| s.as_str())
136            .or_else(|| self.encoding.map_code(code))
137            .map(|g| self.glyph_simulator.string_to_glyph(g))
138            .unwrap_or(GlyphId::NOTDEF)
139    }
140
141    pub(crate) fn glyph_width(&self, code: u8) -> f32 {
142        // PdfCraft patch (90): /Widths, /FirstChar and /LastChar are required for Type 3 fonts
143        // (Table 110), but a font without them gave every glyph no advance and its text was drawn on one spot. The glyph
144        // procedure's `d0`/`d1` operator states the glyph's width too (9.6.4), so such a font
145        // takes that width, as PDFium does. A font with /Widths is read as before: a code
146        // outside FirstChar..LastChar has width 0 (Table 110), as in Poppler and MuPDF.
147        let w = match self.widths.get(code as usize).copied() {
148            Some(Width::Value(w)) => w,
149            _ if self.widths.is_empty() => self.proc_width(code).unwrap_or(self.missing_width),
150            _ => self.missing_width,
151        };
152        (w * self.matrix.as_coeffs()[0] as f32) * UNITS_PER_EM
153    }
154
155    /// PdfCraft patch (90): whether the font has no `/Widths` (or `/FirstChar`/`/LastChar`), so
156    /// that `glyph_width` falls back on the glyph procedures' `d0`/`d1` widths.
157    pub(crate) fn widths_missing(&self) -> bool {
158        self.widths.is_empty()
159    }
160
161    /// PdfCraft patch (90): the horizontal width `wx` that the glyph procedure for `code`
162    /// sets with `d0` or `d1`, in glyph space. `None` when the code has no procedure, the
163    /// procedure sets no width or its width isn't finite. A procedure the page's content
164    /// budget can't decode isn't remembered, so a later page may still read it.
165    fn proc_width(&self, code: u8) -> Option<f32> {
166        let cell = self.proc_widths.get(usize::from(code))?;
167        if let Some(width) = cell.get() {
168            return *width;
169        }
170        let name = self.glyph_simulator.glyph_to_string(self.map_code(code))?;
171        let program = self.char_procs.get(&name)?;
172        let decoded = crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::context::decode_content(program)?;
173        let mut iter = TypedIter::new(decoded.as_ref());
174        let mut width = None;
175        while let Some(op) = iter.next() {
176            match op {
177                TypedInstruction::ColorGlyph(d0) => width = Some(d0.0.as_f32()),
178                TypedInstruction::ShapeGlyph(d1) => width = Some(d1.0.as_f32()),
179                _ => continue,
180            }
181            break;
182        }
183        let width = width.filter(|w| w.is_finite());
184        // Setting can't fail here: the cell was empty above and nothing in between fills it.
185        let _ = cell.set(width);
186        width
187    }
188
189    pub(crate) fn char_code_to_unicode(&self, char_code: u32) -> Option<BfString> {
190        // PdfCraft patch: upstream only consulted ToUnicode. Many Type3 fonts (e.g. TeX/dvips
191        // bitmap fonts) have none; fall back to the /Encoding glyph names, then to printable
192        // ASCII codes, as other viewers do for text extraction.
193        self.to_unicode.as_ref().and_then(|t| t.lookup_bf_string(char_code)).or_else(|| {
194            let code = u8::try_from(char_code).ok()?;
195            let name = self
196                .encodings
197                .get(&code)
198                .map(|s| s.as_str())
199                // PdfCraft patch: an Annex D.2 alias code reads as the ordinary character;
200                // see `Encoding::text_alias`.
201                .or_else(|| self.encoding.text_alias(code))
202                .or_else(|| self.encoding.map_code(code));
203            name.and_then(crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::font::glyph_name_to_unicode)
204                .or_else(|| (0x20..0x7f).contains(&code).then_some(code as char))
205                .map(BfString::Char)
206                // PdfCraft patch (100): above 126, a name that only numbers its glyph reads
207                // as the code's Latin-1 character when the number is that code and every
208                // numbered name in the font names its own code (`C174` at 174 reads `®`),
209                // as in a Type 1 font.
210                .or_else(|| {
211                    let own_codes = *self
212                        .own_code_names
213                        .get_or_init(|| numbered_names_name_their_codes((0..=u8::MAX).filter_map(|c| Some((c, self.code_to_name(c)?)))));
214                    name.filter(|_| own_codes).and_then(|name| numbered_glyph_name_at_its_code(name, code))
215                })
216        })
217    }
218
219    /// PdfCraft patch: the glyph name `/Encoding` gives a code, as `map_code` reads it.
220    fn code_to_name(&self, code: u8) -> Option<&str> {
221        self.encodings.get(&code).map(String::as_str).or_else(|| self.encoding.map_code(code))
222    }
223
224    pub(crate) fn render_glyph(
225        &self,
226        glyph: &Type3Glyph<'a>,
227        transform: Affine,
228        glyph_transform: Affine,
229        paint: &Paint<'a>,
230        device: &mut impl Device<'a>,
231    ) -> Option<()> {
232        // PdfCraft patch: a glyph procedure may show text in this same font (through
233        // inherited resources), recursing until the stack overflowed.
234        if glyph.nesting_depth > crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::context::MAX_PAINT_NESTING
235            || !crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::context::take_nested_paint(glyph.nesting_depth)
236        {
237            return None;
238        }
239        let mut state = glyph.state.clone();
240        let root_transform = transform * glyph_transform * self.matrix * Affine::scale(UNITS_PER_EM as f64);
241        state.ctm = root_transform;
242
243        // Not sure if this is mentioned anywhere, but I do think we need to reset the text state
244        // (though the graphics state itself should be preserved).
245        state.text_state = TextState::default();
246
247        let name = self.glyph_simulator.glyph_to_string(glyph.glyph_id)?;
248        let program = self.char_procs.get(&name)?;
249        let (decoded, _held) = self.decoded_proc(&name, program, &glyph.cache.type3_procs)?;
250        let iter = TypedIter::new(&decoded);
251
252        let is_shape_glyph = {
253            let mut iter = iter.clone();
254            let mut is_shape_glyph = true;
255
256            while let Some(op) = iter.next() {
257                match op {
258                    TypedInstruction::ShapeGlyph(_) => {
259                        break;
260                    }
261                    TypedInstruction::ColorGlyph(_) => {
262                        is_shape_glyph = false;
263                        break;
264                    }
265                    _ => {}
266                }
267            }
268
269            is_shape_glyph
270        };
271
272        // PdfCraft patch: context clips and shading bounds are in device space; FontBBox is in glyph space.
273        let mut context = Context::new_with(
274            state.ctm,
275            root_transform.transform_rect_bbox(self.font_bbox),
276            &glyph.cache,
277            glyph.xref,
278            glyph.settings.clone(),
279            state,
280            glyph.nesting_depth,
281        );
282
283        let mut resources = Resources::from_parent(self.dict.get(RESOURCES).unwrap_or_default(), glyph.parent_resources.clone());
284
285        // Technically not valid, but also support by Adobe Acrobat. See PDFBOX-5294.
286        if let Some(procs_resources) = program.dict().get::<Dict<'_>>(RESOURCES) {
287            resources = Resources::from_parent(procs_resources, resources);
288        }
289
290        if is_shape_glyph {
291            let mut device = Type3ShapeGlyphDevice::new(device, paint.clone());
292            interpret(iter, &resources, &mut context, &mut device);
293        } else {
294            interpret(iter, &resources, &mut context, device);
295        }
296
297        Some(())
298    }
299}

307struct Type3ShapeGlyphDevice<'a, 'b, T: Device<'a>> {
308    inner: &'b mut T,
309    paint: Paint<'a>,
310}
311
312impl<'a, 'b, T: Device<'a>> Type3ShapeGlyphDevice<'a, 'b, T> {
313    pub(crate) fn new(device: &'b mut T, paint: Paint<'a>) -> Self {
314        Self { inner: device, paint }
315    }
316}
317
318// Only filling, stroking of paths and stencil masks are allowed.
319impl<'a, T: Device<'a>> Device<'a> for Type3ShapeGlyphDevice<'a, '_, T> {
320    fn set_soft_mask(&mut self, m: Option<SoftMask<'a>>) {
321        self.inner.set_soft_mask(m);
322    }
323
324    fn draw_path(&mut self, path: &BezPath, transform: Affine, _: &Paint<'_>, draw_mode: &PathDrawMode) {
325        self.inner.draw_path(path, transform, &self.paint, draw_mode);
326    }
327
328    fn push_clip_path(&mut self, clip_path: &ClipPath) {
329        self.inner.push_clip_path(clip_path);
330    }
331
332    fn push_transparency_group(&mut self, _: f32, _: Option<SoftMask<'_>>, _: BlendMode) {}
333
334    fn draw_glyph(&mut self, g: &Glyph<'a>, transform: Affine, glyph_transform: Affine, p: &Paint<'a>, draw_mode: &GlyphDrawMode) {
335        self.inner.draw_glyph(g, transform, glyph_transform, p, draw_mode);
336    }
337
338    fn pop_clip_path(&mut self) {
339        self.inner.pop_clip_path();
340    }
341
342    fn pop_transparency_group(&mut self) {}
343
344    fn draw_image(&mut self, image: Image<'a, '_>, transform: Affine) {
345        if let Image::Stencil(mut s) = image {
346            s.paint = self.paint.clone();
347            self.inner.draw_image(Image::Stencil(s), transform);
348        }
349    }
350
351    fn set_blend_mode(&mut self, _: BlendMode) {}
352}
